name: irflow-timeline
description: IRFlow Timeline is a high-performance, SQLite-backed DFIR investigation workspace for macOS that turns large forensic datasets, native artifacts, and AI application histories into searchable timelines with source provenance.
author: DFIR Community

scripts.bundle:tools: npm run bundle:hayabusa && npm run bundle:bmc-tools
scripts.dist: npm run bundle:tools && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac
scripts.dist:smoke: npm run bundle:tools && npm run build:renderer && SKIP_NOTARIZE=1 CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac
scripts.dist:dmg: npm run bundle:tools && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg
scripts.dist:universal: npm run bundle:tools && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --universal
